svg.text: Comparative System Analysis: Traditional CCTV Surveillance vs. Lenz Video Intelligence
Technical differentiation between passive video archiving and active automated event extraction

g.text: TRADITIONAL PASSIVE SURVEILLANCE (CURRENT STATE)
• Continuous Unanalyzed Video Recording
Terabytes of footage are archived; over 99% is never reviewed unless an incident is
reported after the loss or damage has already occurred.
• Operator Attention Fatigue
Human monitoring performance declines drastically after 20 minutes across multi-screen
grids, resulting in missed crowd surges, intrusions, and bottlenecks.
• Absence of Operational Telemetry
Managers lack automated data on queue lengths, table dwell times, and parking capacity,
relying on manual counting, delayed walkthroughs, and guesswork.
• Forensic-Only Investigation Workflow
Hours are spent manually scrubbing timelines to locate relevant footage after an event,
creating operational delays and high investigative costs.
RESULT: Blind spots, delayed intervention, and unutilized camera infrastructure.
LENZ VIDEO INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM (PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE)
• Automated Computer Vision Ingestion
Standard RTSP/ONVIF streams are continuously processed using lightweight YOLO models
and ByteTrack tracking to detect persons, vehicles, and relevant objects.
• Human-in-the-Loop Incident Prioritization
Filters background activity and dispatches verified, deduplicated alerts with cropped
evidence snapshots for prompt operator review and acknowledgment.
• Continuous Operational Telemetry
Calculates real-time crowd density ratios, queue lengths, table turnaround dwell times,
and parking bay occupancy without requiring specialized proprietary sensors.
• Indexed Event Storage & Search
Events are stored as structured JSON records in PostgreSQL, enabling millisecond queries
by camera, zone, severity, and timestamp with linked keyframe snapshots.
RESULT: Proactive awareness, reduced operator fatigue, and maximized camera value.

svg.text: Design Note: Lenz augments existing surveillance workflows. It does not replace human operators or claim autonomous intent detection.
